description: Create custom cabinets and furniture from a text prompt. Flatma generates an editable 3D model with real dimensions and panel thicknesses, so you can adjust sizes, shelves, drawers, materials, and other details. Design wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, desks, tables, shelves, and more. Open your project on flatma.com for detailed drawings and cut lists.
